taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Anterior abdominal wall anatomy.

words.clue: Two parallel vertical muscles separated by the linea alba that run down the center of the abdominal wall
Flat lateral abdominal muscle with fibers directed downward and medially, arranged like hands in pockets
Deepest flat abdominal muscle with horizontal fibers, the main muscle of abdominal compression and Valsalva
The upper central region of the abdomen that contains the stomach and liver
Median fibrous line that separates the two rectus abdominis muscles and runs vertically down the abdomen
Ligament that forms the inferior border of the external oblique and marks the groin
Anatomical plane at L1 that passes through the pylorus and the hilum of both kidneys
Abdominal compression maneuver performed during coughing, sneezing, and defecation
Fibrous covering that encloses the rectus abdominis muscle and forms its anterior and posterior layers
Small triangular muscle present in 80 percent of people, located anterior to the rectus at its lower end
Tissue layers including Camper's fascia that form the covering and envelopes of the abdominal wall
